description: Search Booksy businesses by keyword, browse a category, look up business IDs or profile URLs, or export reviews across 17 Booksy markets.

acceptsBooksyPay.description: Keep only businesses that accept Booksy Pay.
acceptsBooksyPay.title: Accepts Booksy Pay

acceptsGiftCards.description: Keep only businesses that accept Booksy gift cards.
acceptsGiftCards.title: Accepts Booksy gift cards

availableOn.description: Optional date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Keeps only businesses with availability on that date. Leave empty for no date filter.
availableOn.title: Available on date

businessIds.description: Booksy business IDs or full profile URLs (modes byBusinessId and reviews). Examples: '688238' or 'https://booksy.com/en-us/688238_name'. URLs also select their own country.
businessIds.title: Business IDs or profile URLs

category.description: Service category to browse (mode=byCategory). Categories that are not offered in the selected country return an honest 0-result message.
category.sectionDescription: Category browsing, result ordering, and an optional availability date.
category.title: Category (mode=byCategory)

country.description: Which Booksy marketplace to use. Set the location to a city in the same country.
country.title: Country / Booksy market

filterCategory.description: Keep only business records whose primary category matches this value. Applies to business modes.
filterCategory.title: Only these categories

hasOnlineServices.description: Keep only businesses offering virtual/online services.
hasOnlineServices.title: Online services only

hasSpecialOffers.description: Keep only businesses with an active special offer or discount.
hasSpecialOffers.title: Special offers only

includeDetails.description: Fetch the full profile for each result (services with prices and durations, staff, hours, amenities, contacts, booking policy, review sample). Adds one request per business (modes search, byCategory, byUrl). Profile lookups always fetch details.
includeDetails.sectionDescription: Optional extra requests per business. The daily test keeps these off.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full business details

includeReviews.description: Fetch more written reviews per business and add them to topReviews (business modes). Adds review requests per business.
includeReviews.title: Fetch additional reviews

isRecommended.description: Keep only businesses marked as recommended by Booksy. Applies to business modes.
isRecommended.title: Recommended businesses only

latitude.description: GPS latitude for location-based search (modes search, byCategory). Overrides the Location field when both latitude and longitude are set.
latitude.sectionDescription: Optional override for the city name and how far around it to search.
latitude.title: Latitude

location.description: City or area to search near (modes search, byCategory). Local-language city names work (e.g. 'Warszawa', 'Kraków'). Leave empty to search the whole country. Latitude/longitude override this field.
location.title: Location (city or area)

longitude.description: GPS longitude for location-based search (modes search, byCategory). Overrides the Location field when both latitude and longitude are set.
longitude.title: Longitude

maxItems.description: Maximum business records to return (or review records in reviews mode). Booksy caps a single query at 10,000 results; narrow the category, location, radius, or filters to reach more.
maxItems.sectionDescription: The daily test keeps this small.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxRating.description: Only include businesses rated at or below this value (0-5). Applies to business modes.
maxRating.title: Maximum rating

maxReviewsPerBusiness.description: Maximum written reviews to keep per business when includeReviews is on, or in reviews mode.
maxReviewsPerBusiness.title: Max reviews per business

minRating.description: Only include businesses rated at or above this value (0-5). Applies to business modes; reviews mode exports reviews unfiltered.
minRating.sectionDescription: Filters applied to returned records. They do not reduce the number of pages fetched.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviewCount.description: Only include businesses with at least this many reviews. Applies to business modes.
minReviewCount.title: Minimum review count

enumTitles: By Category — browse one service category
By Business ID — full profiles for IDs or profile URLs
Reviews — export written reviews for IDs or profile URLs
By URL — paste Booksy search and/or profile links
mode.title: Mode

openNow.description: Keep only businesses that are open at the moment of the run.
openNow.sectionDescription: Server-side filters applied by Booksy's own search.
openNow.title: Open now only

radiusKm.description: Radius in kilometres around the location (modes search, byCategory). This is a hint to Booksy's search; Booksy may widen it when nearby matches are thin. Use distanceKm on each record to filter strictly.
radiusKm.title: Search radius (km)

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for (mode=search). Required for search mode; an empty or missing value is rejected instead of falling back to a default. Examples: 'hair salon', 'barber', 'nail salon', 'massage', 'eyebrows'. Use the market's language for non-English countries (e.g. 'fryzjer' in Poland, 'peluqueria' in Spain).
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Result ordering for search, category, and URL search runs.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

startUrls.description: Booksy search-result pages and/or business profile pages (mode=byUrl). Search pages are paginated automatically; profile pages return full details.

url.description: A Booksy search-result page or business profile URL.
url.title: Booksy URL

startUrls.title: Booksy URLs

title: Booksy Beauty & Wellness Business Profile Scraper Input
